title: Concerns About Peer Reviewers Inflating OA Scores [D]
summary: The paper is largely incremental, with very little improvement over existing work. One of the reviewers gave a one-line weakness that isn't even a real weakness, despite having a high confidence score and is giving a high OA score. Another review appears to be AI-generated, follo
reason: Reddit discussion post about peer-review scoring concerns; it is commentary/community discussion with no original paper, benchmark, or official source link, so no rule (including research 2-1) applies.
